figures.title: The normative boundary around narrowing
figures.alt: Specified None and user-defined guard behavior sits apart from general inference behavior that the typing specification leaves open.

figures.title: A TypeGuard gives a checker-readable positive test
figures.alt: A user-defined predicate checks dictionary evidence and narrows the true branch to the ReadingEvent TypedDict.

figures.title: Write and test every runtime case

figures.title: External shape in, domain model out

figures.title: Choose a structure that matches the boundary

figures.title: One container preserves different payload types

figures.title: Overloads connect inputs to precise outputs

figures.title: Basilisk searches type information in order
